notes.title: Update 0.14.1
notes.content:
[h1]New Styxosaurus[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/9678a715d9addebfe76479ccb49cbede4721b04d.png[/img]

[h2]Ichtyosaurus remake[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/09c3a133a6e8da3845b8219fafe8f71df19cdd88.png[/img]

[h2]Other major changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new GFX and SFX for collisions with Sand, Wood, Ground, Coral and Grass / Foliage
[*] Clowntrigger spawns removed
[*] Dunkleosteus increased max speed -> fixed stamina spending
[*] Titanichtis increased max speed -> fixed stamina spending
[*] Pinky increased max speed -> fixed stamina spending & increased roaming so the don't just circle at spawns
[*] Tigershark -> fixed biting animation
[*] Kronosaurus -> fixed turning and navigation + smoothed out movement
[*] Mantis shrimp -> increased base speed + fixed stamina spending
[*] Knightia -> fixed swim animation & reduced speed
[*] Norway redfish -> fixed swim animation
[/list]

[h2]New game launcher & Cheatmod[/h2]
For now you will be asked whether you want to launch the game old way or with the launcher.

As we're slowly adding modding and extensions support, the launcher comes with simple solution to DLL modding. The launcher is also targeting .Net4.8 so required framework will be automatically downloaded and installed if missing.

[h3]Cheatmod[/h3]
Cheats as used to be in game are now only enabled with the cheatmod, as to prevent accidentally using them and then not being able to finish achievements.

Cheats currently in game are:
[list]
[*] L + I = add points
[*] L + U = level up / fill stomach in survival mode
[*] D + X = kill self
[*] F4 = ON/OFF - AI takes control over your fish ( we've been using this to debug behaviors, but then it's quite useful or fun to play with )
[/list]

[h3]Modding - current state[/h3]
Currently modded DLLs can be placed into custom folder inside the "/Mods/" folder located in the games local files.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/3c31a9e3dc99ab18e742b981b4061660707f81f1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/86308f67418e2c4dd72415b0e3196f18aac91340.png[/img]

Those with "Assembly-CSharp.dll" (if checked) will temporary rewrite "/Feed and Grow_Data/ManagedAssembly-CSharp.dll" with the one inside the mod folder, and so the game will be launched with that dll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/55abd0a11eb19297cf806a1ef2fea515cb416dc6.png[/img]

In close future we will be adding content modding via Unity Assetbundles downloaded by steam workshop. So far we're planning to implement custom maps, scenarios, fish and their skins.
[i]A complete guide to creating mods (DLL and Content) with examples will be published as soon as steam workshop gets turned on.[/i]

Thanks,
As always, looking forward to next update!

notes.title: Update 0.13
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/080d426c2602a1f428c9d0b2fc9bff28fa57dd51.png[/img]
[h1]Update 0.13[/h1]
In today's update, we're coming out with first steps into Coral Reef map ( previously called Ocean map ). Which we are transforming into survival friendly form. Additionally after months of hard work with our pals [b]Grand Beats[/b] we're proud to show off first major step towards new amazing music and sound effects.

[i]Jump-in and let us know what do you think![/i]
[h2]Coral Reef map changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/ba406aa6a5952f15f6fa34a25ecce09121a3d618.png[/img]
One of the biggest challenges towards Survival mode was the overall ecosystem of the Reef map. Over time we filled it with a lot of different species that had no / very little participation in the overall food chain.

[i]Some were removed some added, so far. Yet the kind of the ocean keeps it's throne.[/i]

[list]
[*] Dunkleosteus - removed
[*] three new Parrotfish - added ( so far they only differ randomly in coloration )
[*] Blue Tang and new three Tang fish - added
[*] Butterfly fish - added
[*] Cuttlefish - added
[*] Small destroy-able mollusk-like food - removed
[*] Sea urchin - added ( deals damage on contact ! )
[*] New animated light
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/9d0d31894bc3c5f8ad2dd1cac927c5ddc9129a48.png[/img]
Onward to the better, yet keeping the old feeling, we've updated the behavior of the most predators in the Reef map. This includes Moray eel, Grouper goliath, Barracudas and both Tiger and Hammerhead sharks. The main problem we've been facing was to create a focused role for each kind of fish. Eels correctly hide in crevices. Sharks seek and target meaty prey. Barracudas collectively strike upon smaller schools of fish.

[i]Did you know? Bibos was originally meant to be the single-one Big-Boss of the map. However that shark eventually took over that role, as he had better resolution model :D.[/i]

[list]
[*] Goliath - new model & better stats
[*] Hammerhead - new model & better stats
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/ed782c281a174e336281a63b75c800fb5103986a.png[/img]


[h2]New Audio[/h2]
Finally first audio rework is here! All thanks to amazing work by the Grand Beats who did all the work on music composition and sound effects. The best thing is there's more to come!
[list]
[*]After this update audio settings will be reset to 75%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/ff6950edbab4d3e3d92c9384729336e508fa1491.png[/img]
[i]Big shout out for them and their amazing work![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/c3b1d77d8c011adb89ecbdd43e34d488a2263a1b.png[/img]
[h2]Other changes & bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]New lighting and animations in Fish select, you can now rotate and zoom on to fish model by holding LMB and moving the cursor / scrolling with MMB
[*]Increased the power of Brightness slider setting in Graphics by 3 times
[*]Fixed / adjusted random fish movement, that caused some very active fish to shake when idling or resting
[*]FIxed a bug where King crab and his countless army would attack their own spawned eggs
[*]Fixed crabs movement bugs when ragdolls were ON
[*]Fixed mantis shrimp walk / swim bugs when ragdolls were ON
[*]Reduced mantis shrimp damage by -66% and adjusted his attacking behavior
[/list]

That's all for today, have fun,
looking forward to next Update!

notes.title: Update 0.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/12210ddaa01e97f77254445eb07b9ccfe15d88b7.png[/img]
[b]Are you prepared to face what it takes to survive in the Swamp?[/b]
Hatch, eat, grow and secure bright future for your offspring. Sounds easy? Take a look at what can get into your way! As the swamp water levels always change you are put in front of annoying competitors, hungry predators and tempting rewards. Observe your environment and take advantages of it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/df72d35d9c0f45bf81976cae446e4a1731775eb9.png[/img]
[b]Survival changes[/b]
Digestion & Healing processes in survival mode have been changed to appear earlier and slow down when your fish is moving. AI will no longer gain experience instantly after eating, instead attempt to rest and digest the food.

[b]Dead-match[/b]
Since many of you have ask for this feature, coins gained in dead-match mode will now be saved with upper limit of 1000 per map. The limit is added so the gameplay won't lose the risk/gain element.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/5948e3ee1a391a3b324346954b0740536f86e96f.png[/img]
[i]- note that this won't work after using cheats[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/1c1dee6d74d698450ac29291ea75cd2b0c2345c3.png[/img]

[b]Other changes[/b][list]
[*] Re-balanced Snakehead damage and attack speed, added Rage passive
[*] Changed Arowana hunting behavior to prefer eating babies
[*] Changed Catfish hunting behavior to prefer large fish
[*] Wachuma has been removed
[*] Ubur has been removed
[*] Raptors in swamp are enabled only in Dead-match mode
[*] Bottom dwellers ( Carp and Sturgeon ) have new passive ability that helps them to find hidden food
[*] Pikes in swamp got transformed into Muskellunge
[*] Scared fish AI now uses sprint only if a predator is facing its way.
[*] Added new option to toggle VSync on/off into Video settings, by default it is turned on
[/list]

Thanks,
as always, looking forward up to next update!

[b]Dolphins and Sailfish![/b]
This update comes with three new Dolphins species, Swordfish -> Sailfish and sardines changes. notes.title: Update 0.11.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/d7251bbaa50e9d370f93245e68a6cbc3687eddce.png[/img]
[b]Survival game mode[/b]
From now on you'll have to play through three different fish life-cycles, completing all tasks you have been given will unlock a Star based on the difficulty you have chosen. ( Easy = Bronze, Normal = Silver, Hard = Gold ) Each star will permanently unlock species for each tier.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/99a6d50963a530d3494b98193cef8db6d8ee26c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/b874961f06839e64e75ae8353b5ff5d1dc25dd35.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/117bdfe8c27e39e0641f395064b1fc058fdda992.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/7c826003f12603fc142967379cf9ab10dde825c2.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/abd1b82b840be93af272ed1b99e9a71951fa0eaf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/b17126fc6497c0c500b35f8c0abb574a35fb52de.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/d0b012a35d7ab1e41527580e3baf8484fa534a8a.png[/img]
[b]Mating & Eggs laying[/b]
After mating you can't gain experience, any gathered experience is used to develop eggs. Once the eggs are fully developed you can continue
leveling up. Hatch delay after laying has been increased to 60seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/7d7a503f24d11ffea7f7683d551ee7a2d91604e5.png[/img]
[list]
[b]Hunger & Condition[/b]
[*]Hunger no longer affects your stamina regeneration
[*]Hunger bar is now always visible next to stamina
[*]Eating now gives only 1/3 of experience
[*]You can't eat if you're full ( > 95% stomach )
[*]If you're above 75% of your stomach ( bar will turn white ), you can rest (don't move for few seconds) to digest. This will reduce your stomach content to 50% and either give you the remaining 2/3 of experience or refill your condition. (prioritizes Condition)
[*]New: Condition (next to HP), acts as healing reserve and slowly degrades over time
[*]You can't heal just from eating. Resting will start to consume your Condition, healing you in the process.
[/list]

[list]
[b]AI[/b]
[*]New obstacle avoidance for fish, fish should no longer get stuck trying to get out of water when scared
[*]Now sees vegetation as obstacle, therefore you can now hide in grass
[*]Now randomly looks for food in longer distance instead of just static radius
[*]Raptor hunting behavior has changed to utilize Ambush
[*]In survival mode if fish falls below 20% hunger it will abandon it's fish group and search for food alone
[*]In survival mode if fish falls below 20% hunger it may try to attack and eat anything as desperate move
[/list]

[list]
[b]CAMERA[/b]
[*]Added new water level anti-clipping, so camera will not get inside your model when looking down
[*]Added new terrain anti-clipping, so camera will try to position itself correctly in narrow space
[*]New auto-spectating controller, (LMB) to switch to a random creature, (RMB) to gain full control
[*]After death the controller will spectate last creature that damaged you
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/47c022b247bd578346ab9fa76b2d88b94b72cf79.png[/img]
[list]
[b]Other major changes[/b]
[*]New on bite scales ripping FX
[*]Some species now have slightly shifted HSV on their materials per individual fish
[*]Increased accuracy on player/terrain collision detection so your fish can no longer bypass terrain in high speed
[*]Taking more than third of your max. HP will critically wound you for 5 seconds
[*]New "move" "tail slap" has been added to most fish, it can be activated by double pressing shift. Has a chance to break bite and stun anything holding on you from behind. Chance is higher the smaller they are than you.
[*]The force needed to break a bite joint now scales with fish size and it's mouth type ( small fish won't be able to just bite on bigger fish and ride it ) ( strongest: teeth, claws, weakest: beak )
[*]Reduced duration of Electric eel shock stun, also fixed a bug where it would shock you even if dead.
[*]Swamp lurker has unfortunately went extinct in Swamp.
[/list]

[b]Aligator gar[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/5d0806638229340c3ba0ac9484fc691470250f95.png[/img]
[b]BlueGills[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/4901723ccec4c6f2a9736e3df6bd9b00b0944a53.png[/img]
[b]Carp & Sturgeon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/4825704a5cd80c088d3d862d6f195d6bce653394.png[/img]
[b]Snakehead - new model[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/422b681a1ca0461c703060f128382b2a6e803195.png[/img]
[b]Catfish - new model[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/95c2f1afee93ed1c8259cc09c484a1d072e467d1.png[/img]
[b]Pike - new model[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/d2b6af6c35c5a6ccd14ba4ca8447ae8ec1cea194.png[/img]
[b]Perch - new model[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11474502/de7f31e51495045c78de5186f6e6048402eafa84.png[/img]


Sorry for the late update, we've been refactoring the game code and that took us way more time than we expected to get the game running again without many game-breaking bugs. The refactoring was mainly aimed to get the game running at better frame-rate and with fewer crashes.

Now that's done and we get back to work on content, we'd like to ask you for suggestions on Passive / Active abilities for species that don't have any. For example the Carp and Sturgeon have only temporary ones.
Post them here please: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/429050/discussions/1/]Suggestions Forum[/url]

Once again, thank you for your patience.
As always, looking forward to next update.

notes.title: Christmas event
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/618e9cb53c3d802286dd42ac6793dab3564bb4af.png[/img]
[h1]Merry Christmas everyone[/h1]
We're bringing back Christmas event so anyone who haven't opened their gifts year ago have now their chance to do so, for those who did Santa crabs have left one more gift.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
Despite this is not a real update, some of the changes we're working on behind the scene, have managed to slip in.
[list]
    [*]We've cut the prices of fish to remove the grind it took to spawn as one - mainly in Great map.
    [*]We've reduced experience required to level up as very big fish ex.( Bibos Lv 50) to reduce late grind.
    [*]Water rendering has been heavily optimized for each graphical quality level.
    [*]Tiger shark now has more accurate model. Also reduced the passive swimming speed on sharks.
    [*]Fixed behavior of Aigialosaurus who seemed to ignore everything.
    [*]Ocean map has gotten some of it's parts finally finished.

notes.title: Update 0.9.2 - Cretaceous reptiles
notes.content:
[h1] Mosasauroidea[/h1]
In late cretaceous ages a super-family of marine reptiles dominated seas and oceans.Scaling from early tiny mosasaurs like [b]Aigialosaurus[/b] whose probably took advantage of cold-bloodness, breathing air and kept distance close to the shores where their stronger arms and legs could be of use.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/e0373aa4edac7f34ae2b61c989b8d5d14cf28f94.png[/img]

Up to late massive [b]Prognathodon[/b] that developed a special fluke on their tails that gave them the thrust while swimming. These late 'mosas' gave up on their walking agility in trade for swimming efficiency. They also possessed a very interesting feature that is yet only known to moray eels - Second pair of internal jaws which were useful (with combination of tongue) in devouring flesh since their teeth were for gripping not for cutting into smaller pieces.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/31a40a23a790059be000387310e302068e4d7158.png[/img]

Thanks to all of these features mosasaurs eventually out dominated their older siblings the Pliosaurs such as [b]Kronosaurus[/b]. They used very unique way of swimming that can only be compared to turtles or birds. Depsite being the biggest in early cretaceous they simply could not compete with modern mosasaurs, even if they had stronger jaws and were very efficient in swimming for long distances, simply too slow in acceleration. 

Therefore they went extinct.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/5526af89c0336687e0a5ccfaabd2bb65bbf50ecb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 - Placodermi
notes.content:
[h1] Placodermi - Armored fish [/h1]
This extinct, prehistoric class of jawed fish once dominated the oceans have been resurrected in this update.

Placoderms were in many ways very similar to sharks whose have been developing alongside placoderms. As air bladder was not yet evolved in their times, both of them required thick, not very movable pectoral fins that helped them to convert motion into sinking, rising or being upright. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/fb9e8909e4eb818410c6d0a2d3e29c326ab17408.png[/img]
[b]Titanichthys[/b] - Great map
[i] - largest placoderm that decided to go whale-filtering style[/i]

Armor on their head and thorax did not allow for very efficient gill movement, so they had to keep swimming to not drown. But unlike the naked sharks the armor also reduced their elasticity and streamlining making them very vulnerable to attacks from back. They had to face any attacker with their head, so they developed a large tail fin to counter the turning problem.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/cd85fff1086db5cad801ebd6fef433f2da259253.png[/img]
[b]Coccosteus[/b] - Ocean map
[i] - a very tiny placoderm - literary mini dunk would be ideal for aquariums[/i]

Most of placoderms turned their facial armor plates into thick ( not real ) teeth that were very effective at crushing / breaking through most of Devonian prey armor (mostly arthropods and other placoderms).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/6e0634429e0be571991da9f6e5b1bcff366a4996.png[/img]

notes.title: Great Map | Survival mode
notes.content:
[h1]Ooh the update...[/h1]
We've been trying so hard to fulfill the Feed & Grow: Fish potential so we have became obsessed with the non-perfection. That has grown into such a scale, when we just could not push out an update. Each in-development commit has became overplayed in between us over dozens of hours. We've seen errors and bugs everywhere, no matter what it was.
[i]It seemed non-perfect...[/i]

Everything could be improved in so many ways... Yet in the meantime we've realized that the game is meant to be enjoyed by both players and developers. [i]srsly sry...[/i]

[h1]Finally the Update[/h1]
In survival mode you spawn as an egg, hatch, fight your hunger, escape predators, survive, grow up, reproduce, Then take care of your young. As we don't want to make reproduction among all creatures generic and repetitive. Yet we want your feedback during the whole development. We've decided to complete the survival mode update by update.

In this first update you can play as 3 small coral fish species which have (Non-Gender -> kek) reproduction completed, other bigger / more complicated species will be implemented with upcoming updates.

This mode uses different in-game point system that does not reset to 0 when you close the game. You gain points by reaching maturity (lvl3) and by growing your offspring into maturity without dying. 
[i]Note* The more expensive your species are, the more points you gain.[/i]

notes.title: Snakehead - Patch notes 0.7.10
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/75cf025974c53ce6ddd87a09223b262a229e8836.png[/img]
[h1]Snakehead[/h1]
This new cool looking predator hunts in Swamp map. He comes from your suggestions discussions in the Steam community. So thanks for pointing out this cool looking fish!

ℙℝ𝕆𝔽𝔸ℤ𝕐 - http://steamcommunity.com/app/429050/discussions/0/133263024017866538/
WARandRUIN - http://steamcommunity.com/app/429050/discussions/0/405692758700188539/

*Note: [i]We always read the discussions but not every creature idea fits the engine, controls and rendering pipeline but we'll do our best to add them all into the game![/i]

With this one we're learning and testing [b]new techniques to better texture & animate creatures[/b] for the future. Unlike other fish who only slowly turn their chests and drag tails behind, the Snakehead also turns his head resulting in way smoother and nicer looking movement. If no critical performance errors will happen we may use this reanimation technique on other fish that suffer from turning such as Barracuda or Nilin.

Currently the [b]Snakehead[/b] has only a basic passive ability derived from sharks, as we couldn't come up yet with anything better fitting him. 

[b] ---  That's why we ask you to suggest an better fitting ideas for abilities, please post them into comment section below.[/b]


[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Swamp Lurker - the turtle[/b] - has received a complete visual rework as well as some AI & Controls changes, so he no longer gets stuck in the caves spinning around like crazy. Active [ Hide in shell ] no longer makes the turtle invincible, but rather reduces damage taken to 20%. Additionally his price, size, health and damage stats have been normalized down a bit.
    [*][b]Mamaka[/b] - the puffer fish - fixed a bug with passive & active abilities when they did not deal damage if they destroyed something before.
    [*][b]Raptor[/b] - AI count has been increased to 30 from 10
    [*][b]Ubur[/b] - AI count has been increased to 30 from 15
    [*][b]Catfish[/b] - Has received new animation post processing ( same as the Snakehead ) - so it no longer moves like a wooden stick, devouring capacity has been also increased.
    [*][b]Diava[/b] - AI count has been decreased to 20 from 25, Spawn size has been reduced.
    [*][b]Wachuma[/b] - AI count has been increased to 30 from 20, Spawn size and growth speed have been adjusted.
    [*][b]Swamp map[/b] - added new rocks to fill in some weird flat places on terrain.
    [*][b]Swamp map[/b] - added new soft mushroom food so tiny raptors can fulfill their bellies.
[/list] 


[h1]Partial controller support[/h1]
We've added new tab to view button mapping for Xbox One controller as many people were asking for it. The current implementation should work just fine for gameplay with re-spawning, however to change fish or map you'll need to use mouse.

The current mapping is fixed ( cannot be changed ) but not final we're looking for  advises from more experienced controller players to help us finish the default one.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/d500cced71899b626e6d0408e9d635b539a9a549.png[/img]

[h1]What's coming up next?[/h1]
As you guys often requested we've started working on a new really large map that will be 16 times bigger than ocean map and deep as ocean map is wide. We're really excited about this as it will let us add way bigger creatures and cool new ecosystems. It will take us really a lot of time to create such a giant map, but the first playable version should be up in early June.


And that's all for now, 
Thanks a lot for your support!

notes.title: Patch 0.7.9
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/7ebee97ae72623d39e7062b588323c5d18e058ca.png[/img]
[h1]New trailer[/h1]
We've added new trailer that should better represent the game in current state while keeping the old one to show the progress over last year. Check it out!

[h1]Spectator mode[/h1]
To record the trailer we've used spectate mode, but we had to make few changes just to adjust few camera and rendering options. During recording we found out that it could be pretty interesting and fun options for you guys. So now you can slow down time, turn off UI and tone up focus.

[b]To adjust the spectator press:[/b]
[list]
    [*][b][ F1 & ( + / - ) ][/b] to slow down or speed up time ( won't work in multiplayer mode )
    [*][b][ F2 & ( + / - ) ][/b] to pull in or push away focal point - this is most noticeable while keeping aperture high ( 15.0+ )
    [*][b][ F3 & ( + / - ) ][/b] to increase or decrease aperture - this makes the focal point sharper and everything else way more blurry.
    [*][b][ F12 ][/b] to turn on/off all overlaying interface - this should be pretty useful in making screenshots and video clips.
[/list] 


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/2df03d5e9ab1a4bd1aef180082be1a56da069ac5.png[/img]
[h1]New puffer fish - Mamaka[/h1]
This new cute and funny species are still in development and testing phase, hopefully we won't face any game breaking bugs. They are poisonous, and it's suggested to better stay away when they're inflated.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/d15ceab938b53a329646e1920b239239448835c5.png[/img]

Thank you guys for all your support! We're looking forward to release next update!

notes.title: SHARKS! Patch 0.7.5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/ae5c55020193bce76ba072b8f87376eee82ef2be.png[/img]
[h1]The Great White [/h1]
[i]Scarier, bigger and stronger than before, also playable[/i]

Have you ever been so big - that you could devour everything in front of you just by pressing one mouse button? Have you already overthrown the King of the Ocean?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/ba4ecfec87b6ef6bcf6693ffbfdbc656c4765315.png[/img]

[b]No?[/b]
 -> ...

[b]Yes?[/b]
 -> Then sorry, cause you'll have to defeat the him once again in order to replace him! ( kek )

This great white king, despite his look is one of the most peaceful resident of ocean. Keeping an eye on big fish ( while leaving food behind to help smaller ones ), this buddy has been balancing the ecosystem of ocean since Megalodons became extinct. Is it not so?

[i]( by the way it's not possible to gain the achievement by hosting a server )
( also crabs have their own league of ranks - Ocean is place of many kings )[/i]


[h1]Tiger shark[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/ac1a3990bf5ccbaa53ab70f91d3d767a57f30a5e.png[/img]
The smaller cousin of big king no longer suffers from *umm... d* syndrome :D, instead it gets a complete visual remake featuring sharper teeth and a passive ability. 

On it's path tearing it's prey into pieces, given the persistence, easily climbs up to point of challenging his bigger competitor ( ofc not a Browurag ).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11474502/b94090b3e9601f58d7d3e4092bb78fe8f850544d.png[/img]

[h1]Electroreception[/h1]
Oh, yes, how could we forget Hammerhead in a shark update??? 

Theoretically hammerhead sharks have evolved a 'wider' head while spreading their electro-sensitive-receptors that allow them to sweep for potential prey further. ( They basically feel life around them ) For further reading we suggest reading a very interesting topic on Wikipedia -> 
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electroreception

That's why we're updating this passive ability into active ability, practically it work's the same, with the exception that now it reveals creatures behind obstacles.


[h1]Controls & Camera[/h1]
[b]Camera rotation dynamics[/b]
Is a new option in contols settings, that allows you to control behaviour of your camera more preciesly. To put this out simply, if you want a sharp view and camera reacting to your mouse movement immediately set this to low. Incase you preffer to get dizzy while being wiggled in mouth of a shark - feel free to set it high.

[b]Mouse sensitivity[/b]
The slider in setting has now way more influence on the overall sensitivity, make sure you adjust your own to a just fine value.


[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[b]50ms to 500ms[/b]
Delay in-between AI logic ticks has been heavily optimized for smaller fish in far distance. Therefore they may seem a little bit laggier and dumber. The distance ( at which they become dumb ) is optional and can be changed by dragging LOD slider in graphics setting. This change should really help slower machines ( those that had < 31.25 fps ) to run the game way smoother.
[i]However due to the game's nature this optimization does not apply to multiplayer -> as it's using only host camera position point to calculate the distance, in this scenario we'd suggest to pull Fish amount down a bit.[/i]

[b]Food disappearing[/b]
Static food such as starfish, when destroyed into smaller pieces now disappear after 15 seconds rather than randomly sink into floor occasionally stuck in between rocks where nobody could eat it.


[h1]Other changes[/h1]
We have fixed some major crashes as well as updated some audio effects, re-balanced damages and added new animations to creatures with different attacks such as crabs.


Thank you guys, that's all for now, as we're eager to work on next update.
Enjoy the feeding!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.7.4
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Added a new powerful crustacean into ocean map ( just for now unplayable, but soon it will be ).
    [*]Unity3D version has been downgraded from 5.4.4f to 5.4.2f2 - as last upgrade caused various errors, crashes and pink screens. Hopefully this will fix those issues.
    [*]Passive ability "Snap" - max. bonus damage increased to 300% from 100%. ( yep, Browurag is so op now )
    [*]Improved performance - biting and eating no longer allocates redundant memory.
    [*]Increased fish amount in Ocean map by 30%.
    [*]Fixed a physics bug that caused two or more entities to fly out the map if they ate the same food at once. This was most noticeable on crabs.
    [*]Swordfish's "nose" no longer rockets out food into space on hit.
    [*]Great white shark has no longer 2 spawns, and no longer roams too far from the ship wreck ( he used to get stuck on beach ). 
    [*]Teotaca bite speed has been doubled.
    [*]Red crab damage has been doubled.
    [*]Fixed trilobites - they did not eat food ( they just kept damaging it ).
    [*]Fixed an bug that caused Gang fish AI to just sit around watching you to die. Now they either get scared or swim in and help you.
    [*]AI is now way more accurate when eating food - just so they don't miss 2 out of 3 attempts before successfully devouring it.
    [*]Large fish now drop way more meat.
    [*]Meat is now way easier to eat.
    [*]Eating food now regenerates missing health a lot more.
    [*]Fog distance slider has been removed from settings.
    [*]Sun shafts image effect has been removed from settings.
    [*]Motion blur image effect now is now combined with depth blur - therefore is now optional.
    [*]Brightness slider has been added into settings.
    [*]Fixed game crashing when hosting a server.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE - Patch 0.6.43
notes.content:
[h1]Finally[/h1]
We have hacked through most important compability issues, that kept us away from pushing new updates. And so this update is pretty 'fed' and 'grown'. :D

Looking forward to see what what do you think!

[h1]Swamp map remake[/h1]
[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/screenshot_cave.png][/img]
We wanted to test out our new volumetric terrain system, and the swamp was last map that ever recieved any update. It used to have fish species that were already playable on other maps and the map it self was not really looking as swampy as we wanted it to. So we have decided to remake completely.

[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/screenshot_5-beta.png][/img]
 - The map now features several unique species, yes, including [b]Swamp Lurker - the snapping turtle[/b] which was not originally ment to be playable (you will notice why - hard controls). But due to all the hype around it in comment section, we're putting it out there with 101 coin cost. :)

- Shrimps in swamp map have been replaced with [b]worms[/b], who should replace their role just fine.

However most of the work done will remain invisible, as it will be featured in the upcoming survival mode.


[h1]DirectX 11 rendering and other visual changes[/h1]
[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/patch 0.6.34 screen.png][/img]
[i]If you notice any visual bug or glitch try restarting the game or changing a map, if the issue persists please let us know in the comment section below. [/i]

[b]Water[/b]
- Surface shaders have been completely rewritten, now supporting proper reflections and refractions.
- Depth ( or fog one might call it ) rendering has been also rewritten and it no longer enlights the scene, but instead it absorbs and spreads light. This means looking up you will see the water being enlighten while below it should be darker.

[b]Invisibility and camouflage[/b]
[i]Previously only one species could go invisible - the Dreu Eel. However there was a glitch that broke the rendering so much it actually made the eel more visible. [/i]

notes.title: Update 0.5.8
notes.content:
[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/patch-0-5-8-image.png][/img]

[h1]Main Update[/h1]
[b]NEW - Wounds and bleeding[/b]
Just a work-in-progress visual effects that should enhance the gameplay up a bit. Wounds themselves heal / disappear after a while being at full health points.
[i]The wounds are visible only on Graphics Quality "Good" and above.[/i]

[b]Wiggling[/b]
All fish now wiggle a bit after landing a bite. Aside of the damage it now also disorientates and your prey, giving it less chance to escape.

[b]Sprint[/b]
Sprint stamina usage is now much more important for hunting and surviving. Sprinting consumes stamina faster, but at the same time gives a greater speed boost.

[b]AI[/b]
Artificial intelligence has been modified just to fit all of the changes, in other words AI from now has better reaction times and overall is less likely to get stuck.

[b]Regeneration[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fish, crabs etc. no longer regenerate health after taking damage for 2 seconds.
    [*]Stamina regeneration is now reduced the more damaged the fish is.
[/list]

[h1]Eating update[/h1]
As we are steadily moving towards our goal of implementing a fun herbivore gameplay, several changes have been made to eating:
[list]
    [*]Coral food such as starfish now have to be destroyed into pieces in order to eat it as a small fish. Fruits and shrimps can still be devoured instantly.
    [*]Medium and large sized fish now leave one or more of some new gigantic chunks of meat, that need to be chewed down into smaller pieces to eat them.
[/list]

[h1]Gaining experience and Coins update[/h1]
We have greatly reduced ( -65% ) the experience required to level up for small fish and increased it a bit for large fish ( +10% ). Additionally in the Normal difficulty fish drop +25% more experience in meat, this bonus experience becomes +50% in Hard difficulty .

Coins are now easier to obtain, as eating meat now gives one additional coin.


[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/King-crab-devlog.png][/img]
[h1]Crab madness returns as a full mode[/h1]
Originally we hacked together this mode for the aprils fools event, but since the community liked it so much we’ll be improving it gradually so that it can be a full mode and it will be permanently available.

[b]First set of changes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Crabs can now jump
    [*]Crabs can now move sideways
    [*]Crabs have been given new animations
[/list]

For players that permanently unlocked the crab madness mode during april fool’s prior to this update, we are sorry for going back on our word to bring the mode back only during april fool’s and we'll be rewarding you with a special achievement to mark your victory against the evil crab king.

notes.title: Crab Madness escalates! Two weeks left!
notes.content:
[h1]The Evil King Crab has taken over the ocean. But there is still hope![/h1]
Two weeks after the Crab Madness launch the Crabs are going even more insane.
[i](probably due to the "hard" difficulty... *cough*)[/i]

And so we came up with a great new challenge and a huge reward!

[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/King-crab-devlog2.png][/img]

[h1]Become a King Crab - build your own crab army - defeat the Evil King Crab and take his scepter[/h1]

[b]A quick guide on how to:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Achieve Level 10 as an ordinary red crab and unlock the King Crab achievement.
[*]Spawn as the King Crab and start building your own green crab army.
[*]Feed and Grow yourself and your green crab army.
[*]Lead your army into glorious battle against the Evil Crab King.
[*]Defeat him, take his precious scepter and become a Conqueror Crab!
[/olist]

Those who achieve the legendary status of Conqueror Crab will unlock the Crab Madness mode permanently. Those who don’t, unfortunately will have to wait until the next April.

[b]Few tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]As a Red crab, the easiest way to grow up is to find a good spot with lots of small herbivorous fish, open a claw and wait for them to swim into it. Then after a few levels you might be able to prey on bigger fish.
[*]As a King Crab your army will attempt to follow you more or less in a straight line. So don't go behind big obstacles as they might get lost.
[*]As a King Crab, don't charge into the Evil King Crab first, let your troops sacrifice themselves for their King. (He is also pretty strong for a crab.)
[/list]


[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/King-crab-devlog.png][/img]

[h1]Rendering pipeline changes[/h1]
We have done a few changes to the rendering pipeline. But that required us to change a few settings. By default the Graphics quality settings are now on Fantastic, with Bloom and Ambient occlusion turned on.

- If you are having a very low frame rate after this update, do the following:
[olist]
[*]Open Graphics category in Settings.
[*]Turn off Ambient occlusion image effect.
[*]Reduce the Quality to Simple or better.
[/olist]

And don't worry, this game is not getting renamed into "Feed and Grow: Crabs" :) - There is a lot of new stuff coming up soon.

See the river image below.

[img=http://www.feedandgrow.net/images/River-devlog.png][/img]
Yes, that's a very spectacular pike!

[img]http://feedandgrow.net/images/dragonfish-name-beta-testing-feed-and-grow-fish-game-steam-update-07-03-2016.png[/img]

How did the naming fun end? And what's the story about beta testing? Plus is there anything else coming Steam way? Well, let's dive into the answers!

We asked all of you to have a sip of the creative juice and come up with ideas on Mr. Dragonfish Nameless's name. You came up with so many cool ideas that both us, the devs and Mr. Dragonfish loved. So which one is it gonna be?

Yet again, more work for you all :) We're picking (and not fighting over it, we „promise“ :D) the ones that we loved the most. The tough fight as there can be only one winner, will be decided on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/feedandgrow/]Facebook[/url], so check it out. We'll finish „fighting“ the top chart soon :)

[img]http://feedandgrow.net/images/dragonfish-name-beta-testing-feed-and-grow-fish-game-steam-update-07-03-2016-2.png[/img]

[h1]It starts with „B“ and end in „eta testing“[/h1]
Yes, we have so many game features to release and we'd love some more hands-on feedback before we throw the updates into the waters of Steam community. Therefore we want to ask you guys, if you'd be up for beta testing events? 

If so, stay tuned, will be releasing the whole concept soon. All you need is love... the game and some time to play the game and look into the features tested :) we appreciate feedback from all players, casuals and pros, whatever the sticker is :) Each testing will get more players in and there are other fun ideas coming for the beta testers.

[h1]Any other news?[/h1]
Aye, captain. New map is under development and shipshaping nicely (we can't wait to hear what the fresh beta tester think about it). On top of cool new environment to feed and grow, there are going to be new features added too. And rewards :)

So check out F&G: Fish on Facebook for Mr. Dragonfish christening party and we'll keep you posted on beta fun soon.

Cheers,

Nika | Feed and Grow: Fish Dev Team

notes.title: Patch notes 0.4.5
notes.content:
[h1]Help us to find a NAME for this fish[/h1]
[i]Post your ideas into the comment section below.[/i]
[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/new-dragon.png][/img]
Cost: 35
Health: 61
Damage: 11
Bite speed: 0.7/s
Swim speed: 2.1m/s
Weight: 11kg

Passive ability: Devour


[h1] Patch notes [/h1]
[b]Bugfixes and Optimalizations[/b]
- Fixed a bug where if you attempted to connect to a server it would refuse your connetion, saying that your game version is too behind.
- Fixed "Direct IP" dialogue typing.
- Fixed a bug where you would skip a level when leveling up.
- Optimalized fish LOD (level of detail) distance calculations and added a slider to the graphical settings. At default it is set to 50% so you might want to pull it up a bit.

[b]Controls[/b]
- All fish now accelerate two times faster than before.
[i]( this has been changed back in last patch 0.4.4, but we forgot to list it in the patch notes )[/i]

[b]Balance changes[/b]
[i]Just a few balance changes mirroring our behind the scenes progress.[/i]
- Browurag - Swim speed has been increased to 2.5m/s from 2.0m/s.
- Tiger shark - Damage has been reduced by 20% but Bite speed has been increased by 30%.
- Blue octopus - Swim speed has been reduced to 1.5m/s.
- Bibos - Base damage has been increased by 20%.
- Klej - Both damage and health have been reduced by 10%.
- Catfish - base health has been reduced by 33%, damage has been reduced by 50%.
- Passive ability Devour - the max. size of fish you can swallow whole has been reduced to +50% instead of +125% but the recharging now takes only 10 seconds instead of 20.

[b]Graphical settings[/b]
- Added Level of detail slider, by using this one you can customize LOD draw distance a bit. If you have a stronger machine feel free to pull this up.


[i]If you would like to watch a timelapse creation of the new fish look here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ix-_fhAFPIM[/i]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.4.4
notes.content:
[b]Nilin got a visual rework and a new passive ability - new model, texture, animations and teeth[/b]
[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/new-nilin.png][/img]

[b]A new challenging prey. The gold fish.[/b] - Not playable (yet)
This little quick buddy, will take a big role in one of the gamemodes that we are comming up with soon.
[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/new-gold.png][/img]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug with biting that was randomly infinite damage. ( the one shoting )
- Kill zones that used to destroy your fish when you have attempted to leave the map are now blocked by invisible walls.
- Fixed a bug where if too many objects were active at once ( over 4086 ) some of them would be deactivated but not destroyed.
- Fixed a bug that caused a memory leak when you had opened settings.
- Fixed a bug that caused particles, such as blood, to not render on certain GPU.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Bones now slowly fall and sink.
- Klej has been given a new passive ability: Snap.
- Nilin has been given a new passive ability: Bleed.

[b]Damage and experience labels[/b]
Those small numbers that show up whenever you deal, take damage or gain experience.
- The labels now have a black outline for better reading.
- When dealing or taking damage less than 2, the number will be rounded to one decimal point. (eq. "1.5" )
- When taking damage, the labels are now comming from the same direction as the damage came.

[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/biboss-old-new.png][/img]

- The multiplayer ports can now be changed. defaults are
STEAM:19132,
TCP:19132,
UDP:19133

notes.title: Multiplayer polishes and gameplay updates
notes.content:
Bubbles, unlimited mode, easy game or hard challenge... The latest update steps up the game both in single and multi player version. Two new fish will say more soon. Read on for more info.

[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-new-update-1.png][/img]

[h1]Like it easy or hard?[/h1]

If you felt like the game got too easy, feel like that no more. The latest update brought 2 major changes. First of all you can choose the difficulty of the game, the options being easy and hard (oh hard really is hard :) but give it a shot yourselves).

[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-new-update-2.png][/img]

On top of that there's a new mode available, the Unlimited. A.k.a. The question is, what's the highest level you can reach? Yes, 10 is not the answer. And in hard level, even number 3 may feel like a challenge. Other fish have passed their school exams and really, they are much smarter now.

[h1]Stepping up multiplayer[/h1]
Multiplayer is the holy grail and that's why it need proper care. The results are much more subtle, yet those of you, who played it before will notice smoother gameplay. On top of that, try the new cute chat solution :) We're curious what you think about them bubbles.


[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-new-update-5.png][/img]

[h1]Oh, last but not least...have you met 2 new characters?[/h1]
Have your say in the comments bellow :) we're eager to hear from you! Cheers, guys!

[img=http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-new-update-4.png][/img]

notes.title: Crash fixes and what's up next
notes.content:
The dreaded 89% freeze has been bitten and destroyed, the game should start smoothly now. Have a look at other changes, more of a minor character and have a look at a brief overview of further updates, including access to features before public release.

[img]http://feedandgrow.net/images/feed-and-grow-crash-troubleshooting-help-early-access.png[/img]

[h1]Crashes, begone![/h1]
Oh, the equivalent to the blue Windows screen, now hopefully gone for good. We found the culprit and bit him hard, with the new feature, that colours your teeth to see how close you are to your prey :) The incompatibility should be fixed now. In case there are further problems, please, follow the Steam troubleshooting guide and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/429050/discussions/0/451850849185648646/]more info found here in our discussion[/url]

[img]http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-1.png[/img]

On top of that the game includes several other minor updates. When you get to a „biting distance“ from your prey, your teeth will change colour to indicate your fish is ready to do some damage. Other changes are to be found in the UI, we tried to make it friendlier, plus the gameplay and NPC fish were modified slightly. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/429050/announcements/detail/72423053371122848]More info on exact updates is in our patch notes here[/url]


[img]http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-2.png[/img]

Is there anything else you'd love to see fixes? Drop us a line in the comments below!

[h1]Bring on the fun[/h1]
Yes, that's our very next target, both for single and multiplayer version. We will pack further technical fixes to future updates, which will be focused more on fun. A.k.a. The Gameplay. You've been asking for it and we've been working on it :) Yes, the fun content is getting shipshaped and will be available in game in the next series of larger updates. 


[img]http://feedandgrow.net/images/first-update-feed-and-grow-early-access-survival-simulator-game-steam-3.png[/img]

Various game modes will await your opinions and verdicts. Stay tuned for more info on single player scenarios, achievements, multiplayer servers (oh, yes, servers, please) and multiplayer game modes, inlcuding deathmatch :)
 
[i]PS: Feed and Grow will be opening its beta testers club, which includes access to features before public release, including testing with the devs and other perks. More info coming soon next week![/i]

See ya all in the waters of Feed and Grow: Fish!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Crashes[/b]
- Fixed DirectX incompatibility that caused the game to crash at 89% loading.
- If there are further technical probs, please, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/429050/discussions/0/451850849185648646/] have a look at our troubleshooting discussion and info here.[/url]

[b]Video[/b]
- Added Video options to the Settings menu
- Added resolution option
- Added full screen option

[b]User Interface[/b]
- Game-play menu now opens when pressing "ESC" instead of "TAB".
- holding down TAB now shows all online players in multiplayer mode.
- Recreated fish selection.
- Added "Resume" button to game play menu.
- Fixed few bugs with buttons.
- A ">" icon will now popup whenever you click on some category button.
- Added a quick tutorial-like controls to game-play menu.
- Recreated a bit more fancy map selection for Single-player
- Changed "Leave game" button to "Back to Main Menu"
- In-game state such as "Press [Space] ... " now has a black outline.
- Added background screenshot to Main Menu.
- Added thankful early access message to Main Menu.
- Added "Quit" button to Main Menu

[b]Game play[/b]
- All fish now change velocity direction 2.0x faster than before. You might notice it while swimming at high speed and quickly turning to side. It's more responsive now.
- Overall NPC fish population in Single-player has been increased by 50%. ( from 66% to 100% total )
- When the great shark kills something, food will no longer appear. ( scavenging was too op, sry )
- The teeth effect is now properly located in center of your hit box.
- The teeth effect while biting now indicates when ever you are close enough to bite or you already bitten something. ( orange = close enough, red = bitten )
- Reduced on hit slow from 90% to 30%. ( this should make escaping much easier )

[b]Camera & Controls[/b]
- Camera now changes FOV (field of view) based on your fish velocity.

[b]Artificial Intelligence[/b]
- Fixed that awkward fish staring at food. :D
- Fish should be now less likely to swim in circles when trying to bite each other.
- The forever alone fish that have no friends now seek friends in larger distance if forever alone too much.
- Max fish in one Group reduced to 7 from 14.
- Bibos will not chase prey too far from it's group.
- Raptors now will always try to hunt the same prey as other Raptors in their group.
- The Great Shark will now only actively hunt fish bigger than 1.5m. (was 1.1m)
- Tiger sharks roam more.
- The turn speed for big fish has been slightly reduced.

[b]Multi-player[/b]
- Fixed few invisibility bugs and discovered new ones. ( we plan to fire all our resources on multiplayer during this week )
- Fixed few exceptions that were causing inability to spawn.
- Fixed few exceptions that were causing inability to move.
- At this moment we are setting up first testing dedicated servers.
